items.title: Pay Betriebskosten-Nachzahlung (service charge back-payment)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie die Nachzahlung innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Zugang dieser Abrechnung.
items.computation: The letter sets a 30-day payment period running 'nach Zugang dieser Abrechnung' (from receipt of this statement), not from a printed document date. The letter itself bears no date (no 'Datum' field is printed anywhere on it), and no actual receipt date was given either. Since the landlord is a private company, not a public authority, no statutory deemed-delivery rule (Zugangsfiktion) applies automatically to fix the start of the period — the actual day the tenant received the statement must be used instead. Without that day, the 30-day deadline under § 187(1)/§ 188(1) BGB (period starts the day after receipt, ends 30 days later, shifted to the next business day if it would fall on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday per § 193 BGB) cannot be pinned to a calendar date. The person should check the postmark or the actual day the letter arrived and count 30 days from the day after that.

warnings: The letter carries no printed date (no 'Datum' field), so the start of the 30-day payment period ('nach Zugang dieser Abrechnung') cannot be computed exactly; use the actual day the statement arrived (e.g. envelope postmark) to count 30 days from the next day.

The IBAN DE47 3705 0198 0003 3221 10 is well-formed and passes the checksum, but this only confirms its format, not that it truly belongs to Hausverwaltung Musterkamp & Söhne GbR; verify the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory recipient check (Empfängerüberprüfung) before transferring the 341,82 € Nachzahlung.
